title: Lesson promotion becomes an explicit operating layer
what_happened: The shared intelligence architecture was extended with a canonical event schema, latest-learning feed, promotion protocol, Primary Intelligence Hub, and deterministic promotion runner.
intended_outcome: Ensure material learning becomes discoverable shared intelligence and, when appropriate, a durable system control.
actual_outcome: The protocol and machine-readable event contract now exist; deterministic validation/classification and deterministic Naya/Human note promotion are implemented. Governance-sensitive destinations remain authorization and verification gated.
lesson: The intelligence system must not merely store lessons; it must convert material lessons into better future system behavior.
value: Reduces knowledge loss, successor rediscovery, and repeated mistakes while creating a single latest-learning surface.
recommendation: Feed every material learning event through the promotion runner, then verify the resulting control and record the receipt.
next_action: Run the promotion validator in CI on intelligence-event changes and extend promotion handlers for approved non-governance durable destinations.
successor_instruction: At cold start, read Runtime Briefing, then Primary Intelligence Hub, then the newest relevant Intelligence Feed entries before substantive execution.
